setup: A point is \([[distance]]\) units from the centre of a circle of radius \([[radius]]\), and a tangent is drawn from the point.

steps.say: A tangent meets the radius drawn to the point of contact at a right angle, which is the fact that turns this into a right triangle rather than a circle problem.
The radius \([[radius]]\), the tangent segment and the distance \([[distance]]\) from the point to the centre form that right triangle, with the distance as the hypotenuse.

answer: So the tangent segment is \([[tangent]]\) units long.
